label: TRUE_UNDOCUMENTED
justification: purchases[offerId] is a storage array that grows one entry per fill() with no cap, and _closeOffer (auto-triggered when stock hits 0) loops over the whole array. An attacker can cheaply bloat it via many small fills, making _closeOffer exceed the block gas limit so the offer can never close, locking the NFT and seller payment. Real DoS, distinct from the documented logic_rounding bug.
